concerns.location: plan.md:Data Acquisition (addresses **T008**) – line referencing the ExtractionDataset URL
concerns.text: The plan uses the open **ExtractionDataset** as a proxy for MobileForge logs (see the cited URL). FR‑001 explicitly requires extraction from *MobileForge logs*; substituting a different dataset does not satisfy the research question and constitutes a wrong‑dataset choice.

concerns.location: plan.md:Evaluation (step 6) – mention of "full MobileForge visual policy" without a verified URL or citation
concerns.text: The baseline "full MobileForge visual policy" is referenced but no verified source or URL is provided. All external resources must be cited with a reachable URL to satisfy Constitution II and the FR‑001 data‑source requirement.

concerns.location: plan.md:Technical Context – evaluation of the full MobileForge visual policy on a CPU‑only runner
concerns.text: Running the full MobileForge visual policy likely requires GPU resources and exceeds the CPU‑only, 6‑hour wall‑clock budget. Including this baseline violates the resource constraints (FR‑008, SC‑003) and makes the pipeline infeasible under the stipulated compute limits.
